description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Kiribathkumbura, Yatinuwara D/S Division, Kandy District (25/0139)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains specific land parcel details, ownership information, cadastral references, and declarations of title settlement for various land plots, including both private and state-owned properties. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it primarily concerns land registration, title determinations, and property ownership matters.
